blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As state-of-the-art text-to-image flow models achieve near-photorealistic quality, controlling their outputs, e.g., suppressing harmful content while promoting benign alternatives, has become a central challenge. The current steering paradigm consists of adding a global steering vector to selected activations. While functional, a fixed and example-agnostic vector applied uniformly along the entire trajectory cannot adapt to the changing state of the generation and often causes unintended global changes. We introduce Steering Fields , a generalization of steering vectors that adaptively re-estimates the steering direction at each step of the generative process. Steering Fields operate on the noisy states of flow models, expose a continuous trade-off between steering strength and content preservation, and are compositional, enabling the simultaneous induction and inhibition of concepts, setting a new state of the art on safety steering benchmarks. Despite using no explicit spatial masks or object priors, the trajectory-adaptive estimation naturally preserves local structure, in a manner reminiscent of image editing. In fact, Steering Fields can serve as a structure-preserving image-editing technique that achieves state-of-the-art semantic fidelity (CLIP, VQAScore), while remaining model-agnostic and inversion-free.
blocks.zh: 由于最先进的文本到图像流模式实现了近似现实化的质量,控制其输出,例如抑制有害内容同时推广良性替代品,已成为一项中心挑战. 目前的指导范式包括在选定的激活中添加一个全局的指导矢量. 在功能上,固定的和可知性的矢量在整个轨迹上统一应用,但不能适应一代人不断变化的状态,往往造成意外的全球变化。 我们引入了“引导领域”,即对方向矢量的概括,可适应性地重新估计基因过程每一步骤的方向。 指导场在流线模型的喧闹状态上运作,暴露了方向强度和内容保存之间的持续权衡,并且具有组成性,能够同时诱导和抑制各种概念,为安全引导基准设定了新水平。 尽管没有使用明确的空间面具或物体前身,但轨迹适应性估计自然保留了局部结构,其方式让人联想到图像编辑. 事实上,指导场可以作为一种结构保存图像编辑技术,实现最先进的语义忠诚(CLIP,VQAScore),同时保持模型不可知性和无反演性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Background
blocks.zh: 1 导言和背景

blocks.en: Generative modeling for vision has long been driven by a single goal: making images as realistic as possible given input text ( Karras et al., 2020 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) . Modern flow-based models have all largely closed this gap ( Labs et al., 2025 ; Kamali et al., 2025 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , and the bottleneck has shifted from how to generate better images to how to control what is being generated.
blocks.zh: 愿景的基因模型制作长期以来一直由单一目标驱动:使图像尽可能现实化,给出输入文本(Karras等人,2020年;Saharia等人,2022年;Peebles和Xie,2023年)。 现代流动模型基本上都弥补了这一差距(Labs等人,2025年;Kamari等人,2025年;Esser等人,2024年),瓶颈已从如何生成更好的图像转向如何控制正在生成的东西。

blocks.en:
Steering has emerged as a particularly attractive paradigm for control ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Arditi et al., 2024 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Konen et al., 2024 ; Rodriguez et al., 2024 ; Rodriguez et al., 2025 ) : a steering vector is a direction in the activation space of a generative model that, when added to selected activations during inference, biases generation toward or away from a target concept, without retraining and without modifying the architecture.
Steering is especially relevant for safety-critical settings – inhibiting harmful content such as violence or nudity while preserving overall generative capacity ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) – and can also induce attributes such as style, composition, or specific semantic content ( Konen et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2020 ) .
Despite its appeal, the current steering paradigm rests on a brittle assumption: a single, fixed steering vector is applied uniformly throughout the generation, agnostic to the specific generation example and to changes over the trajectory. As generation progresses from noise to coarse structure and fine detail, a constant shift cannot match the local geometry of the activation manifold, and classical steering often induces uncontrolled global changes beyond the target concept, damaging the composition and local structure of the generated image ( Im and Li, 2025 ; Mayne et al., 2024 ; Facchiano et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
指导力已经成为一种特别吸引人的控制范式(Turner等人,2023年;Arditi等人,2024年;Rimsky等人,2024年;Konen等人,2024年;Rodriguez等人,2024年;Rodriguez等人,2025年):指导力是基因模型激活空间的一个方向,当在推论中加入某些激活时,偏向或脱离目标概念,不进行再培训,也不修改结构。
指导尤其与安全关键环境相关 — — 抑制暴力或裸体等有害内容,同时保留总体遗传能力(Gandikota等人,2023年;Shen等人,2026年) — — 也可诱导风格,组成或特定语义内容等属性(Konen等人,2024年;Shen等人,2020年)。
目前的指导范式尽管具有吸引力,但基于一个不折不扣的假设:在一代人中统一使用一个固定的引导矢量,对特定一代人的例子和轨迹的变化是不可知的。 随着代代从噪声向粗细结构发展,细细细节,恒定的转变无法与激活倍数的局部几何相匹配,古典方向往往诱发超出目标概念的无节制全球变化,破坏生成图像的构成和局部结构(Im和Li,2025年;Mayne等人,2024年;Facchiano等人,2026年).

blocks.en: In this work, we address this limitation by lifting steering from a fixed vector to a vector field . We introduce Steering Fields , a generalization of steering vectors that adaptively re-estimates the steering direction at each step of the generative process, conditioned on the current state of the trajectory. Steering Fields are model-agnostic – they apply to any flow model regardless of architecture – and operate on latent state representations rather than on a hand-picked layer or module. A single parameter controls the trade-off between steering strength and content preservation, and they are compositional: the same formulation supports both inducing desired concepts and inhibiting undesired ones, through complementary attraction and repulsion mechanisms. Mathematically, classical activation steering is recovered as the special case of a constant field.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过将方向盘从固定矢量升到矢量场来解决这一限制。 我们引入了“导线场”,即对导线矢量的概括,它以轨迹现状为条件,根据基因过程的每个步骤对导线方向进行适应性的重新估计。 引导场是模型不可知的 — — 无论结构如何,它们都适用于任何流线模型 — — 并且运行在潜在的状态表示上,而不是在手工挑选的层或模块上。 单一参数控制方向强度和内容保存之间的权衡,它们具有组成性:同一配方通过互补的吸引力和反作用机制,既支持诱导理想的概念,又抑制不受欢迎的概念. 数学上,古典激活方向盘作为恒场的特例被恢复.

blocks.en: A perhaps surprising property emerges from this formulation. Although Steering Fields prescribe no explicit spatial mask, no object-level prior and no structural regularizer, the per-step adaptivity along the trajectory naturally preserves the local structure of the generated image. This behavior is reminiscent of image editing ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Hertz et al., 2022 ; Brooks et al., 2023 ; Kulikov et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Zarei et al., 2026 ) , a related but distinct line of work that takes an existing image as input and modifies it to match a target description while preserving the rest of the image. Editing methods typically rely on inversion ( Mokady et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2021 ) , attention manipulation ( Hertz et al., 2022 ) , or explicit spatial masks and latent-region constraints ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zarei et al., 2026 ) to anchor structure, whereas Steering Fields achieve structure preservation as an emergent consequence of trajectory-adaptive control, without inversion and without explicit anchors. In Steering Fields the same mechanism that steers generation also edits an input image, enabling direct comparison with the editing literature on standard benchmarks. While image editing is not the primary aim of our framework, applying the same trajectory-adaptive mechanism to this setting yields particularly strong semantic adherence , measured by CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , confirming that this adaptive control faithfully implements the requested change.
blocks.zh: 这一提法产生了或许令人惊讶的财产。 虽然"引导场"没有规定明确的空间掩码,没有对象级别前置和结构调节器,但沿轨迹的每步适配性自然保留了生成图像的局部结构. 这种行为让人联想到图像编辑(Meng等人,2022年;Hertz等人,2022年;Brooks等人,2023年;Kulikov等人,2025年;Huang等人,2024年;Zarei等人,2026年),这是一条相关但截然不同的工作线,以现有图像作为输入,并在保留图像其余部分的同时对其进行修改以匹配目标描述. 编辑方法一般依靠倒置结构(Mokady等人,2023年;Song等人,2021年),注意力操纵(Hertz等人,2022年),或明确的空间面具和潜在区域限制(Huang等人,2024年;Zarei等人,2026年)来完成锚定结构,而指导场则通过轨迹适应性控制实现结构保全,没有倒置,也没有明确的锚定. 在"引导字段"中,引导生成的同一机制也会编辑一个输入图像,从而可以直接与标准基准的编辑文献进行比较. 虽然图像编辑不是我们框架的首要目标, 但运用同样的轨迹适应机制来设定,

blocks.en: We empirically evaluate Steering Fields on Stable Diffusion 3.5 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and FLUX1 ( Labs et al., 2025 ) . On safety steering benchmarks, our method establishes a new state of the art, substantially reducing the rate of unsafe generations while preserving prompt fidelity. On image editing benchmarks, Steering Fields are competitive with dedicated editing methods despite not being designed for this task, and lead the field on semantic-adherence metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们对稳定扩散3.5(Esser等人,2024年)和FLUX1(Labs等人,2025年)的指导领域进行了实证评估。 关于安全指导基准,我们的方法确立了一种新的技术水平,在保持迅速忠诚的同时,大幅度降低了不安全世代的比率。 在图像编辑基准方面,尽管没有为此任务设计专门编辑方法,但“指导字段”具有竞争力,并在语义-遵守度量标准方面领导这个字段。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • Steering Fields. We introduce Steering Fields, a model-agnostic, trajectory-adaptive generalization of classical steering vectors, and show analytically that activation steering is recovered as the constant-field special case. • Compositional control. Within a single formulation, Steering Fields support both induction and inhibition of concepts via complementary attraction–repulsion mechanisms, with a continuous, user-controllable trade-off between steering strength and structure preservation. • Editing as a byproduct. Steering Fields naturally extend to image editing without inversion, without spatial masks, and without architecture-specific machinery. • Thorough Empirical Evaluation. We evaluate Steering Fields on Stable Diffusion 3.5 and FLUX1, achieving state-of-the-art performance on safety steering benchmarks and state-of-the-art semantic adherence (CLIP, VQAScore) on image editing benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 指导领域。 我们引入了“导线场”, 一种典型导线向量的模型-不可知性, 轨迹-适应性一般化, 并分析显示激活导线被恢复为“恒域特例”。 • 组成控制。 在单一的表述中, " 指导领域 " 支持通过补充的吸引力-推力机制对概念进行诱导和抑制,在 " 指导力量 " 和 " 结构维护 " 之间不断进行用户可控制的权衡。 • 编辑作为副产品。 引导场自然扩展到图像编辑上,没有反演,没有空间遮罩,也没有建筑特有的机械. • 全面经验评价。 我们评价关于稳定扩散3.5和FLUX1的指导场,在安全指导基准和关于图像编辑基准的最新语义遵守(CLIP、VQAScore)方面达到最先进的业绩。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en:
Generative models for image synthesis, like Diffusion ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Song et al., 2020 ) or Flow Matching models ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Liu, 2022 ) , learn a mapping from noise to the complex distribution of real images.
Flow Matching learns a time-dependent vector field v θ ( z , t , | c ) v_{\theta}(z,t,|c) that specifies how a latent state z z should evolve at a specified timestep t t , conditioned on some text prompt c c . As a result, generation in Flow Matching can be interpreted as following trajectories governed by the learned vector field, starting from random noise. This formulation is the foundation of state-of-the-art models, including FLUX ( Labs et al., 2025 ) and Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) .

Flow Matching 学习一个时间依赖的矢量字段 v {(z, t, | c)}v {thetheta}}(z, t, |c)} 指定一个潜在状态 z z 应如何在指定的时间步 t t 中演化, 以某些文本提示 c c 为条件 。 因此,在Flow Matching中的生成可以被解释为遵循由学习的矢量场所规范的轨迹,从随机噪声开始. 这种配体是最先进的模型的基础,包括FLUX(Labs等人,2025年)和稳定扩散3(Esser等人,2024年).

It is a lightweight approach that does not require any re-training, introduces minimal computational overhead and was shown to be effective on a wide range of architectures, from LLMs ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) to diffusion- and flow-based models ( Facchiano et al., 2026 ; Briglia et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, we generalize the steering vector to a steering vector field r Δ ​ ( z , t ) r^{\Delta}(z,t) defined as a function of the current latent state z z and trajectory point t t . As a consequence, the field allows us to integrate a full steered generation trajectory. We develop and analyze this object in Sec. 3 .

blocks.en:
Image editing is a broad and rapidly evolving domain encompassing diverse paradigms: perturbation-based methods ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , attention manipulation ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Tumanyan et al., 2023 ) , instruction-based editing ( Brooks et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and large foundation models for unified editing ( Labs et al., 2025 ) . A common thread in many state-of-the-art methods is the use of inversion to anchor the edited output to the source image structure ( Mokady et al., 2023 ; Ju et al., 2024 ; Avrahami et al., 2025 ) . More recent work avoids explicit inversion: FlowEdit ( Kulikov et al., 2025 ) minimizes the transport cost in latent space between source and target by jointly manipulating the forward and reverse trajectories, while InfEdit ( Xu et al., 2024 ) achieves inversion-free editing through consistency models. Multi-aspect editing poses additional challenges, as single-branch approaches accumulate errors across edits. ParallelEdits ( Huang et al., 2024 ) addresses this with a multi-branch diffusion design. A complementary direction explores continuous, fine-grained control over edit strength via slider-based mechanisms ( Gandikota et al., 2024a ; Baumann et al., 2025 ; Zarei et al., 2026 ) , exposing smooth interpolation between edit intensities.
Steering Fields, in contrast, unify concept induction and inhibition within a single trajectory-adaptive framework that also extends naturally to image editing: conditioning the source velocity on an encoded image latent rather than on noise turns the same operator into a structure-preserving image editor, without inversion, attention manipulation, or spatial masks.
blocks.zh:
图像编辑是一个广泛而迅速发展的领域,涵盖不同的范式:扰动方法(Meng等人,2022年),注意力操纵(Hertz等人,2022年;Tumanyan等人,2023年),指令编辑(Brooks等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2025年),以及统一编辑的大型基础模型(Labs等人,2025年)。 许多最先进的方法中一个常见的线程是使用反转将编辑过的输出锁定到源图像结构(Mokady等人,2023年;Ju等人,2024年;Avrahami等人,2025年). 最近的工作避免了明显的颠倒: 流动 编辑(Kulikov等人,2025年)通过联合操纵前向和逆向轨迹,将源与目标之间潜在空间的运输成本降至最低,而InfEdit(徐等人,2024年)则通过一致性模型实现无反向编辑. 多视角编辑带来了额外的挑战,因为单分支在编辑过程中会累积错误. 平行 编辑(Huang等人,2024年)用多分支扩散设计来解决这个问题. 互补方向探索通过滑动机制(Gandikota等人,2024a;Baumann等人,2025;Zarei等人,2026)对编辑强度进行连续,精细的控制,揭示编辑强度之间的平滑插值.
与此相反,引导场将概念诱导和抑制统一在一个同样自然延伸至图像编辑的单一轨迹适应框架内:在编码的图像潜伏上而不是在噪音上调节源速度,使同一操作员变成一个结构保留图像编辑器,而不反向、注意力操纵或空间面具。

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce Steering Fields, which operate on the latent space of a flow model and unifies attraction to desired and repulsion from undesired concepts in a single closed-form objective (Sec. 3.2 ). We discuss the relation of Steering Fields with classical Activation Steering in Sec. 3.3 following notation of Kulikov et al. (2025) and derivations in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.3 Per-step adaptivity and the relation to activation steering
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 一步步适应性与激活方向的关系

blocks.en: Eq. 6 mirrors the classical activation-steering update of Eq. 1 , with v Δ ≡ v tar − v away v^{\Delta}\equiv v_{\text{tar}}-v_{\text{away}} playing the role of the residual-stream direction r Δ r^{\Delta} . The crucial distinction is that v Δ v^{\Delta} is not a pre-computed constant, but rather a function of the current latent and timestep, re-evaluated at each step t t on the new state z z : v Δ ​ ( z , t ) = V ⁡ ( z , t ∣ c tar ) − V ⁡ ( z , t ∣ c away ) , v^{\Delta}(z,t)\;=\;V(z,t\mid c_{\text{tar}})-V(z,t\mid c_{\text{away}}), (8)

This per-step re-estimation is not an arbitrary modelling choice but a property dictated by the flow-matching paradigm itself. The conditional velocity is by construction a function of ( z , t , c ) (z,t,c) : the same prompt induces meaningfully different velocities at different points of the trajectory, because the local geometry of the latent manifold changes as the sample moves from noise toward image ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu, 2022 ; Liu et al., 2022 ) . Difference-of-means estimators in activation space ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Arditi et al., 2024 ) collapse this dependence into a single direction. Such an estimator would be optimal only if a single direction were correct everywhere along the trajectory; in practice, flow trajectories are rarely straight and are most fragile early in generation, when the latent is dominated by noise and bears little resemblance to the fully-formed activation distribution from which r Δ r^{\Delta} was computed. Steering Fields recover the dependence on ( z , t ) (z,t) at no additional training cost: at each integration step, v Δ v^{\Delta} is obtained from two forward passes of the same flow model, one conditioned on c src c_{\text{src}} and one on c tar c_{\text{tar}} (and analogously for the repulsion term with away ). The resulting vector is a better estimate by construction at every state visited along the trajectory, rather than only on average.

Importantly, the successful suppression of NSFW content comes at no cost of semantic quality on benign prompts,
measured as retention rate on COCO-1k (Table 1 ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Image Editing via Steering Fields
blocks.zh: 4.3 通过引导字段编辑图像

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Comparison against baselines illustrating that inversion-based approaches trade editing fidelity for source preservation, whereas Steering Fields achieves both.
blocks.zh: 图4:与基线比较,说明基于逆向性的方法为维护源进行编辑忠实,而指导领域则实现两者。

blocks.en:
While the primary application of this work is safety, our framework naturally extends to other tasks such as image editing and concept blending.
Here, we investigate image editing in an I2I setup, with Steering Fields applied without fine-tuning, inversion, or task-specific adaptation. To perform editing, we simply perturb the image patches with noise. As described in Sec. 3.3 , conditioning the source velocity on a noised latent image encoding turns the same operator into an image-to-image editor.
blocks.zh:
虽然这项工作的主要应用是安全,但我们的框架自然扩展到其他任务,例如图像编辑和概念混合。
在这里,我们用一个I2I设置来调查图像编辑,在应用"引导场"时,没有微调,反转,或任务特定修改. 为了进行编辑,我们只是用噪音干扰图像补丁。 如第3.3节所述,在噪声潜伏图像编码上对源速度进行调节,将同一运算符变为图像到图像编辑器。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 qualitatively illustrates editing quality and trade-offs between retention of original image features and success of desired edits.
Inversion-based methods, such as StableFlow and RF-Inversion, preserve the source image structure more faithfully but frequently fail to apply the target edit. The painting examples are visually very close to the baseline but do not reflect the target prompt, showing unsuccessful cases of editing. Similarly for FlowEdit, the dog example (bottom) shows partially successful steering that does not fully adhere to the target prompt, failing to generate the zombie. Being inversion-free, Steering Fields execute the edits seamlessly while maintaining good visual coherence.
blocks.zh:
图4从质量上说明了编辑质量和在保留原始图像特征与理想编辑成功两者之间的权衡。
基于反转的方法,如StableFlow和RF-Inversion,更忠实地保留了源图像结构,但经常未能应用目标编辑. 绘画实例在视觉上非常接近基线,但没有反映目标提示,显示出编辑失败的案例. 同样对于FlowEdit来说,狗的例子(bottom)显示了部分成功的引导,没有完全遵守目标提示,未能生成僵尸. 由于无反向,指导字段在保持良好的视觉一致性的同时,无缝地执行编辑.

blocks.en: In Tab. 2 we quantitatively evaluate editing success on PieBench++ ( Huang et al., ) against FLUX Img2Img, RF-Inversion, StableFlow and FlowEdit. Following prior work ( Görgün et al., 2026 ; Avrahami et al., 2025 ) we measure semantic similarity to the editing prompt (CLIP-txt), alignment between change in image encoding space and change in text encoding space between original and edited prompt (CLIP-dir), editing success with an orthogonal LLM-as-a-judge metric (VQAScore) and perceptual quality with HPSv2. Steering Fields achieve the highest CLIP-txt, CLIP-dir and VQAScore, indicating the strongest alignment between the edited output and the target prompt, while performing on par with FlowEdit on HPSv2. CLIP-img is lower than other approaches, confirming our previous finding about the editing tradeoff: inversion-based methods preserve the source image features better, but at the cost of less successful editing.

CLIP-img比其他方法要低,证实了我们先前关于编辑权衡的结论:基于反向的方法更好地保存了源图像特征,但代价是编辑不太成功.

blocks.en: Overall, these results demonstrate that Steering Fields provide a unified framework for controlled generation that sets a new state-of-the-art in T2I safety steering and gracefully extends to I2I editing without architectural changes or task-specific components.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明,指导场为控制生成提供了一个统一的框架,在T2I安全引导中设置了新的最先进的技术,并优雅地延伸至I2I编辑而无需进行建筑改变或任务特定组件.

blocks.en: 4.4 Concept Blending via Steering Fields
blocks.zh: 4.4 通过指导领域组合概念

blocks.en: Lastly, Steering Fields allow for blending of concepts, setting λ = 0 \lambda=0 (Eq. 6 ). Rather than replacing one concept with another, it continuously blends the source and target velocity fields, with α \alpha governing the degree of mixing. Figure 5 shows two examples of concept blending on diverse source prompts. In both cases, the left image shows the source generation and the right shows the blended output. The framework successfully merges semantically distant concepts, such as dogs blended with spaghetti and clouds, while preserving the compositional structure and visual coherence of the source. Notably, blending operates without any inversion or fine-tuning, and the same α \alpha parameter produces visually plausible interpolations across examples.
blocks.zh: 最后,指导领域允许概念的混合,设置 QQ=0\lambda=0(Eq.6 )。 它不是将一个概念与另一个概念相取代,而是不断混合源和目标速度场,由α\α来规范混合程度. 图5显示两个概念混合在各种源提示上的例子。 在这两种情况下,左图像显示源生成,右图像显示混合输出. 框架成功融合了远近的概念,如与意大利面和云混合的狗,同时保留了源的构成结构和视觉一致性. 值得注意的是,混合操作没有任何反演或微调,同样的α-α参数产生各种实例的明显可信的插值。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Examples of concept blending using Steering Fields. By setting λ = 0 \lambda=0 in Eq. 6 , it is possible to blend semantically distant concepts, like dogs with spaghetti (left) or clouds (right).
blocks.zh: 图5:利用指导场进行概念混合的实例。 通过设置 QQ = 0\lambda=0 在 Eq. 6 中,可以将远近的概念,如狗与意大利面(左)或云(右)混合.

blocks.en: Safety-fidelity tradeoff. A key property of Steering Fields is that the tradeoff between safety and semantic retention is continuously controllable via the strength parameters α \alpha and β \beta in Eq. 5 . Increasing β \beta pushes the trajectory further from the unsafe concept at the cost of greater deviation from the source generation, while decreasing it recovers fidelity at the cost of weaker suppression. The density plots of Figure 2(b) visualize this tradeoff empirically: the joint distribution of Steering Fields outputs shows a favorable tradeoff unreachable by competing methods, suggesting that trajectory-adaptive steering exposes a better safety-fidelity frontier.
blocks.zh: 安全诚信权衡. 指导场的一个关键属性是,安全性和语义性保留之间的取舍通过功率参数α\α和β\β在Eq.5中可以持续控制. β β β 的增多使轨迹进一步脱离不安全的概念,而牺牲了对源生成的更大偏差,而减少这种偏差则以削弱抑制为代价恢复忠诚。 图2(b)的密度图从经验上可视化地反映这种权衡:联合分配“指导场”产出表明,通过相互竞争的方法无法实现有利的权衡,这表明,适应轨迹的“引导”暴露出一个更好的安全性和可靠性前沿。

blocks.en: Inversion tradeoff for editing. The editing results reveal a fundamental tradeoff between source preservation and edit fidelity. Inversion-based methods such as StableFlow and RF-Inversion achieve high CLIP-img scores by staying close to the source image, but this conservatism limits their ability to execute the target edit faithfully. Steering Fields operates without inversion, which means it does not explicitly preserve source pixels. This is also what allows it to follow the target prompt more freely, as reflected in the higher CLIP-txt, CLIP-dir, and VQAScore. The right operating point depends on the application: tasks requiring strict source preservation may favor inversion-based approaches, while tasks prioritizing semantic alignment with the target prompt benefit from Steering Fields.
blocks.zh: 反向权衡 编辑. 编辑结果揭示了源头保存与编辑忠诚之间的根本权衡. 基于倒置的方法如StableFlow和RF-Inversion通过保持与源图像的接近来实现高CLIP-img分数,但这种保守主义限制了他们忠实地执行目标编辑的能力. 引导字段运行时没有反向,这意味着它没有明确保存源像素. 这也使得它能够更自由地跟踪目标,这体现在更高的CLIP-txt,CLIP-dir和VQAScore中. 正确的操作点取决于应用程序:需要严格源保存的任务可能倾向于基于反向的方法,而任务则优先排序语义与目标同步,即时从"指导字段"中受益.

blocks.en:
Compositional control. A distinctive property of Steering Fields is that attraction toward a target
concept and repulsion from an undesired one are handled within a single objective
rather than as separate mechanisms. The coefficients α \alpha and β \beta act
independently and additively, exposing a continuous trade-off between steering
strength and structure preservation that the user can control. This is
in contrast to approaches that user fine-tuning or concept erasure,
which commit to a fixed suppression at training time.

blocks.en: A unified, model-agnostic framework. Steering Fields operates directly on the latent velocity of the flow model, requiring no access to internal activations, attention maps, or layer-specific representations. This makes it strictly model-agnostic: any flow model exposing a conditional velocity is steerable without modification. The same operator supports safety steering, image editing, and concept blending within a single framework, with the operating mode determined entirely by the choice of prompts and parameters. We view this unification as an important contribution of the work.
blocks.zh: 统一,模式-不可知框架. 引导场直接运行在流体模型的潜在速度上,要求不能访问内部激活,注意力图,或层特异性表示. 这使得它严格地具有模型-不可知性:任何显示条件速度的流体模型都是可以不做修改而引导的. 同一操作员支持安全引导,图像编辑,以及概念在单一框架内的混合,操作模式完全由选择提示和参数决定. 我们认为,这种统一是对工作的重要贡献。

blocks.en:
Limitations. Steering Fields does not perfectly suppress all unsafe content in all cases.
Prompts that specify intimacy without explicit nudity represent a harder setting
where partial suppression occurs. More broadly, the effectiveness of steering
depends on the choice of c tar c_{\text{tar}} , c away c_{\text{away}} , and the strength
parameters μ \mu and λ \lambda , which currently require manual tuning per
application. Learning these parameters automatically, or adapting them during
inference based on a safety classifier signal, is a natural direction for future
work. Finally, Steering Fields requires two forward passes per integration step
— one conditioned on c src c_{\text{src}} and one on c tar c_{\text{tar}} (and
analogously for the repulsion term) — compared to one for the unsteered baseline,
incurring additional inference cost.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We addressed controlled image generation for tasks such as safety steering and image editing with Steering Fields , a unified framework that generalizes Steering Vectors by adapting steering directions to time and latent-space position.
Steering Fields achieve state-of-the-art safety steering and naturally extend to image editing and concept blending.
Extending the framework to other domains, and integrating inversion into editing to combine effective edits with stronger source preservation, makes for exciting future works.
blocks.zh:
我们处理了安全引导和图像编辑等任务的可控图像生成问题。 指导领域是一个统一框架,通过调整指导方向以适应时间和潜在空间位置,使引导矢量得到概括。
引导场实现最先进的安全引导,并自然延伸至图像编辑和概念混合.
将框架扩展至其他域,并将反转法纳入编辑,将有效的编辑与更强大的源保存结合起来,这为今后令人振奋的作品创造了条件.

blocks.en: We anticipate that Steering Fields offer a new paradigm for controlled image generation to the community that can be applied model-agnostic and across tasks and domains.
blocks.zh: 我们预计,“指导领域”为社区提供了可控制图像生成的新范式,可适用于模型-不可知性以及跨任务和领域。

blocks.en: The results shown so far indicate that Steering Fields achieve state-of-the-art performance on the nudity category. Below, we demonstrate that these results are not confined to the nudity category only, but generalize to other categories as well. Focusing on FLUX1, we replicate the same setting of Tab. 1 , comparing our method against other state-of-the-art baseline on the category of Violence. To do so, we use two well-established benchmarks: T2IRiskyPrompt ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and T2ISafetyViolence ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
